findings.detail: 'code_richcompare' (tp_richcompare) descends into container elements via PyObject_RichCompareBool with no Py_EnterRecursiveCall/Py_ReprEnter guard — a deeply-nested or cyclic object overflows the C stack (SIGSEGV) instead of raising RecursionError. Bracket the descent with Py_EnterRecursiveCall()/Py_LeaveRecursiveCall() (or Py_ReprEnter()/Py_ReprLeave() for repr/str).
